The '''Mk 2/S laser cannon''' was a type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariots]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] modified [[Arrow-23 landspeeder/Legends|Arrow-23 landspeeders]] were armed with a single Mk 2/S laser cannon.<ref name="MBC">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref> [[Mennac Vanderijar|Mennac]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] installed a hidden Mk 2/S laser cannon on her [[Hutt floater]].<ref name="Hutt">{{WEGCite|story=To Hunt the Hutt|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref>
